invariants.description: FAIL-scan middleware must exist in the proxy (moved from log-tool-call.sh after the MCP decoupling -- log-tool-call.sh itself is now a stub)
Event-kernel and Stop-chain subprocess boundaries must use filesystem IPC rather than live stdin pipes, so hook portability does not depend on a specific agent CLI or Node spawn input semantics.

No HME/teams/src source may reach into another process's /proc/<pid>/fd table or acquire a /dev/ptmx master fd to write into a foreign process. Cross-process control must use the sanctioned filesystem IPC (tmp/hme-cc-control.fifo) or the in-band read_chain, never raw fd injection -- which escapes the project-root work boundary by poking a foreign session's PTY and is invisible to every path guard.
invariants.born_from: 2026-06-09 consult PTY foreign-fd-poke subversion (work leaking outside ROOT into another worktree's bridge)

invariants.description: Retired consult/read-chain control paths must not re-enter source or config: no FIFO/readq live input typing, no submit_read_queue_to_pty helper, no HME_CONSULT_READQ nonce prompt, and no local-session [HME_READ_CHAIN] $prompt bridge expansion. The only accepted consult read path is host task-notification -> proxy read_chain_driver -> native Read tool_use with hme_read_chain__ id.
invariants.born_from: 2026-06-10 input-field spam regression: consult proof typed [HME_READ_CHAIN] into the live REPL via readq/FIFO instead of letting proxy read_chain emit native Read tool_use blocks

invariants.description: Shortcut and proxy route causal paths must declare intent, lane, allowed emitter, forbidden emitters, proof ID shape, and negative controls. Wire shortcuts must not become local-session input, and local-session shortcuts must not become API payloads.
invariants.born_from: 2026-06-10 Phase Omega workstream 3: shortcut/route strings must become typed causal transitions with forbidden-path checks

invariants.description: Every rule key defined in check_source_grep_invariant.py RULES must be referenced by an invariant shard, and every shard reference must name a real RULES key. Closes the recurring seam where a guard exists but observes nothing (orphan rule, silently inert ban) or a reference points at a guard that does not exist (dangling ref, enforces nothing). This is the meta-guard: it watches the watchers for the letter/intent gap.
invariants.born_from: 2026-06-09 recursive-seam lesson: letter observed != intent meant; bans must actually run
invariants.success_detail: every RULES key enforced; every shard reference resolves

invariants.description: HME Python files must not wrap `from hme_env import ENV` (or other infrastructure imports) in try/except fallback.
invariants.context: HME Python files must not wrap `from hme_env import ENV` (or other infrastructure imports) in try/except fallback. Silent ImportError swallowed behind `os.environ.get(...)` fallback hid the synthesis_proxy_route ENV bug for weeks. Infrastructure imports must fail loud at module load time.

invariants.description: Active source must not retain stale OVERDRIVE_MODE=6 gates or helper names after mode 1 became canonical.
invariants.born_from: 2026-05-16 overdrive mode 6 retirement to canonical mode 1

invariants.description: Phase 2 (inference proxy)  hme_proxy.js must exist so ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL routing is available
hme_proxy.js must parse as valid Node so starting the daemon never fails at syntax level
Phase 2.1 jurisdiction injection must be wired in the proxy (distributed across hme_proxy.js / context.js / messages.js after the middleware refactor)
Proxy must inject open hypotheses and semantic drift warnings alongside jurisdiction context (Phase 3.1/3.3 -- moved to context.js during the middleware split)
All three wire-version components (cli/proxy/worker) must read from tools/HME/config/versions.json  not hardcoded strings. Protects the three-way version check from typo-drift.
tools/HME/config/versions.json is the single source of truth for cli/proxy/worker wire versions. Must be valid JSON with all three keys.
Proxy route dispatcher must expose GET /version using PROXY_VERSION.
invariants.context: hme_proxy.js declares PROXY_VERSION and passes it into hme_proxy_routes.js; the route dispatcher must expose GET /version. Completes the three-way (cli/proxy/worker) version check surfaced via `hme-cli --version` -- a stale proxy between a new CLI and new worker is otherwise invisible.
